name: onshift
description: Expiring, least-privilege authority for staff and AI agents on ENSv2.

scripts.build: cd contracts && forge build && cd .. && npm run export && npm --workspace app run build
scripts.test:fork: cd contracts && set -a && . ./.env && set +a && forge test --match-contract SepoliaForkTest -vv
scripts.deploy:sepolia: cd contracts && set -a && . ./.env && set +a && forge script script/DeploySepolia.s.sol --rpc-url $SEPOLIA_RPC_URL --private-key $SEPOLIA_PRIVATE_KEY --broadcast --slow --skip-simulation && cd .. && node scripts/export-abis.mjs
